description: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator — Turn prompts, images & clips into 2K video with sound.
pricing: H3Gen is a browser-based AI video generator powered by the MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 03) model. Creators, marketers, and filmmakers can write a shot prompt, upload an image, set first/last frames, or combine up to 15 omni-reference files to generate 4 to 30 second video clips at up to native 2K resolution with synchronized dialogue, sound effects, and ambience rendered in the same pass. Includes 20 trial credits to start in the browser with no installation and commercial usage rights on paid plans starting at $19.90/month.
